ayahOccurrences.text: وَمَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى يَنْعِقُ بِمَا لَا يَسْمَعُ إِلَّا دُعَآءً وَنِدَآءً ۚ صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَمَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى يَنْعِقُ بِمَا لَا يَسْمَعُ إِلَّا دُعَآءً وَنِدَآءً ۚ صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَنْعِقُ is in the derivative form: يَنْعِقُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ع/ق   n–ʿ–q entrance to desert rat’s burrow; croaking, bleating, gibberish, to scream, to shout at herds of goats and sheep, (all) living things. Of this root, يَنْعِقُ yanʿiq, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَنْعِقُ yanʿiq [imperf of v. نَعَقَ naʿaqa, intrans.] to cry out, to shout, to bleat, to croak

(2:171) وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي يَنْعِقُ بِمَا لاَ يَسْمَعُ إِلاَّ دُعَاءً وَنِدَاءً [calling to] those who disbelieve is like [the calling of one] who shrieks to a dumb animal [lit. one [a herdsman] calling to things that hear nothing but a shout and a cry].
